B-03.analysis: Projected demand at +3 years does not justify Phase 3. B-03 is constrained by accessibility friction and a demand–supply gap of 1,300 m². Three candidate strategies were generated from the intervention library.

options.title: Option A · Repurpose
options.summary: Convert to community facility, cancel Phase 3, upgrade the pedestrian route.

options.title: Option B · Retrofit + green
options.summary: Improve building performance and add a green corridor along the north edge.
changes: Green corridor added along the north edge (spillover)

options.title: Option C · Delay + replan
options.summary: Postpone Phase 3 to 2031, until the demand threshold is met.
